scope: Portable CNV_STR_CONF and CNV_CONF_STR with checked outputs and explicit grammar

reference_basis.documented: CONFIG flag categories and fields, conversion signatures, successful status zero and sufficient STRING capacity; native strings require robot validity
reference_basis.uncertainty: No authenticated robot/group masks, full native grammar, invalid-input output state or native error codes

implementation_choices.grammar: ASCII case-insensitive flag letters, at most one per N/F, R/L, D/U, B/T pair in any order; optional three comma-separated Python decimal turns -8..7; omitted flags false and omitted turns zero as portable data
implementation_choices.canonical: Emit all flags in wrist/shoulder/elbow/front order with spaces, followed by three comma-space-separated decimal turns; retain every field without a robot mask
implementation_choices.parse_status: Success 0; portable CONFIG_TEXT_INVALID=1 for malformed grammar/ranges, preserving CONFIG; type/storage/ASCII/length guard failures raise before output writes
implementation_choices.format: Complete initialized CONFIG snapshot before target capture; require sufficient concrete STRING capacity; no truncation or output mutation on guard failure
implementation_choices.outputs: CONFIG and exact INTEGER ordinary writable references, disjoint storage footprints, preserved aggregate storage and captured aliases; CONFIG scalar status aliases stay blocked
implementation_choices.effects: Source/target/status once in source order; both outputs participate in transitive write/FOR checks; prior effects remain and ordinary cleanup applies
implementation_choices.names: Fallback procedures, preserving explicitly declared internal routines with the same names and strict-mode unsupported-call behavior

retained_boundaries: No native robot/group masks, inferred controller defaults, CNV_CNF_STRG or configuration validity claim
No native error/status/alarm mapping, controller contact, binary I/O or kinematics
Existing nominal types, initialization, capacities, reference protections and resource checks; strict remains future work
